name: Pan African University (PAU) Scholarships

fields: STEM, governance/humanities/social sciences, life & earth sciences, water & energy (by institute)

name: AIMS Master's in Mathematical Sciences
country: Any (AIMS centres in South Africa, Senegal, Ghana, Cameroon, Rwanda)
amount: Full scholarship: tuition, accommodation, meals (airfare support encouraged from other sources)

note: One-year intensive master's at AIMS centres; selected students generally receive full scholarships, and admitted students are considered for the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program. The 2026-27 call closed 15 Mar 2026.

amount: Tuition (up to 9 credits/semester), fees, stipend, health insurance, housing allowance or residence

eligibility.note: Non-Egyptian African nationals; those with a second, non-African nationality are not eligible

name: Wellington Master's by Thesis Scholarship
host: Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington
amount: NZ$15,000 tax-free stipend + domestic tuition for 120 points (internationals pay the fee difference)
note: One-year stipend for a master's by thesis, open to international and domestic applicants; international students (except Australians) must pay the difference between international and domestic fees. Applications close 1 Nov each year.

name: Intra-Africa Academic Mobility Scheme Scholarships
host: European Union (EACEA) with African university consortia
amount: Living allowance, insurance, travel/visa, tuition/participation costs (amount depends on project and mobility length)
dlText: Set by each funded consortium project
note: EU-funded scholarships for African students to study in an African country other than their own; apply to the universities of a funded consortium, not to the EU. Only one scholarship per person under the scheme.

name: Israel MFA Scholarships for International Students
amount: 50% of tuition (max US$6,000) + monthly allowance + basic health insurance (8-month academic year)
dlText: By 15 Jan 2027 via the Israeli embassy in your country (local dates may be earlier)

eligibility.note: Citizens of the countries listed on the official page (not Israeli citizens); under 35 at start of the academic year

nominationBody: The Israeli embassy in your country
fields: Programmes approved by Israel's Council for Higher Education
note: One academic year of study or research in Israel for graduates (BA/BSc or higher) from eligible countries; decisions usually come around July. A 3-week Hebrew summer course option also exists.
